wiki.createkontor.page.buyer.title: Buyer
A company is active when at least one member (owner or manager) of the company is online. When the company is inactive (= no member online), the entire company is frozen. The company will not receive requests, order deadlines will pause and chunks may get unloaded. Daily settlements occur when the company has been active on the current trading day at least once, even if a member was only online for a minute.
Business License Fee gets booked
Salaries get booked
Daily License Fees get booked
Storage cost gets booked
Interest for loans and overdraft gets booked
Loan repayments get booked
Legal Form Upgrade Applications may get finished when net worth is sufficient again after resting
Payment status (normal / illiquid) and Insolvency status are updated
Contracts with vanished employees end

Every company is settled once at the end of every trading day. A trading day is the same length as one Minecraft day but does not get manipulated by sleeping or changing the time via commands. Sleeping can only bring the trading days and normal minecraft days out of rhythm (e.g. trading days change at noon and not at sunrise when Minecraft days change), but this does not hurt the economy. During the daily settlement, multiple things happen:
wiki.createkontor.page.employees.title: Employees
wiki.createkontor.page.finances.p1: Each company has a bank account holding the liquid assets of the company. Salaries, fees, purchases etc. are booked from that bank account. Every company starts with a free %s deposit on its account that does not need repayment.
wiki.createkontor.page.finances.p2: A company's net worth is the balance of a company minus its current liabilities (e.g. loans). You can see your current net worth in the Kontor Desk. Legal Level Upgrades require a minimum net worth.
wiki.createkontor.page.finances.p3: The bank account has an overdraft loan. You can use this loan to overcome temporary liquidity shortages. The overdraft limit defines how much you can overdraft the account and depends on the current legal form of your company. You can see your current overdraft limit in the Kontor Desk. When using the overdraft credit, you will pay daily interest for the borrowed money. If you exceed your overdraft limit your company will get illiquid and is not able to spend money anymore.
wiki.createkontor.page.finances.p4: A company's payment status is illiquid, when the overdraft limit has been exceeded. Your liquid assets have been fully exhausted. In this state, you cannot spend anymore money. You can see your current payment status in the Kontor Desk.
wiki.createkontor.page.finances.p5: A company is insolvent, when it has been illiquid for more than %s days in a row.
wiki.createkontor.page.finances.p6: A company is eligible for bankruptcy when it is insolvent. The owner can then declare bankruptcy in the Kontor Desk. Declaring bankruptcy will permanently delete the company so you can start over again with a new company.
wiki.createkontor.page.finances.title: Finances
wiki.createkontor.page.getting_started.p: This article provides some basic guidance for new players. It will guide you through founding your company, buying a first license and completing your first order.

To see this article, you must have already founded a company. But if, for some reason, you have not: Craft a Kontor Desk and right click it. Enter a name and decide whether you want to take the founder's loan. Note that the name cannot be changed afterwards. The founders loan is a cheap loan of %s with %s free days before repayment offered to every founder. After founding, you can right click the Kontor Desk to access the management UI of your company.

To sell items on markets, you need a license for the item you want to sell. A lawyer can buy licenses for you. Craft a Lawyer's Desk and seat a villager next to it using a Create Seat. Right click the villager to open the lawyer UI. Buy a license for your first product(s) in the License Catalog.

With your new license, you are able to participate in the markets that the bought license covers. Right click the Kontor Desk and participate in one market using the Markets tab. Set a price and you will start receiving requests for that product.

Once you participate in a market, you will receive requests for that product. View and accept them in the Requests and Orders tab of the Kontor Desk. An accepted request will turn into an order that you will need to fulfill in time, so start producing the required items to fulfill your first order!

Craft a Shipping Exit and place it down next any inventory (e.g. a chest). When powered, the Shipping Exit will try to fulfill any order it can using items from its adjacent inventories. When an order has been completed, the order will disappear from the Order Book and the payout will be booked to your bank account! Congrats! You just delivered your first order!
Make money and grow your company. You can upgrade your legal form when necessary. Hire new employees to unlock new features. Expand into new markets and build bigger factories.
wiki.createkontor.page.getting_started.s: The most basic setup needed to run a company
wiki.createkontor.page.lawyer.title: Lawyer
wiki.createkontor.page.legal_forms.p1: Legal forms are the legal foundation of a company. They define what a company can do and what it cannot do. You can see your current legal form in the Kontor Desk. A lawyer can tell you the exact limits of your current legal form.
wiki.createkontor.page.legal_forms.p2: A lawyer can upgrade the legal form of your company. To upgrade a legal form, several requirements must be met:
wiki.createkontor.page.legal_forms.p3: The exact requirements depend on the legal form that you want to upgrade to. A lawyer can tell you the exact requirements. Additionally, an application fee must be paid.
wiki.createkontor.page.legal_forms.p4: The upgrade application takes some time to process. During this processing time your company needs a lawyer at all times or the application will be cancelled and the fee refunded. If your company does not have sufficient net worth at the end of the application it will start to rest. It will rest for a few days depending on the applied legal form. After that the application will be rejected and the fee is lost.
wiki.createkontor.page.legal_forms.requi:
Minimum net worth plus application fee
Minimum amount of fulfilled orders
Minimum reputation
No current payment difficulties
wiki.createkontor.page.legal_forms.title: Legal Forms
wiki.createkontor.page.licenses.p1: To be able to sell items on a market, you need a license for that market. You can buy licenses in the license catalog using a lawyer. Licenses might require you to have a certain legal form in order to buy them. Additionally, when acquiring a license you will need to pay a one-time activation fee.
wiki.createkontor.page.licenses.p2: There are two main payment models for licenses: Daily Fee and Revenue Share. The daily fee is, well, a fee that will be booked daily as long as you hold the license. The revenue share is a share of the revenue of each order that you complete using this license.
wiki.createkontor.page.licenses.p3: Many licenses come as bundles, meaning you get licensed for multiple markets. This can lead to overlaps: You can e.g. hold two licenses that both license you to sell iron ingots. In that case, you will need to pay the daily fee for both licenses. But when completing an order, e.g. for iron ingots, you will pay the lowest revenue share of all iron ingot licenses you hold.
wiki.createkontor.page.licenses.p4: You can cancel a license at any time. After cancelling, you will immediately withdraw from any markets that are not covered by a license anymore. With it, you will lose your reputation on markets that you are not licensed for anymore.
wiki.createkontor.page.licenses.title: Licenses
wiki.createkontor.page.logistics_manager: The logistics manager allows you to link a Create Logistics Network to your company. A company may only have one linked logistics network at a time. The owner of the logistics network must be a member of the company. Linking a logistics network requires a minimum legal level.

You can connect a logistics network to your company, by attaching a stock link to the staffed Logistics Manager's Desk. A chat message will inform every online member of the company that a logistics network has been linked. Equally, a chat message will notify every online member when the logistics network gets disconnected.

Managing your storage costs money (additionally to the salary of the Logistics Manager). One item costs %s per day. The fee depends on how many items were stored how long in the logistics network and is billed at the end of each trading day. When the network is disconnected, the fee for the current trading day so far is booked instantly. The Logistics Manager can show you an estimate of the storage cost per day.

The Logistics Manager can automatically send items needed to fulfill orders from the connected logistics network to a set target address. When correctly combined with a Shipping Exit you can automate order delivery using the Logistics Manager.

While Automatic Order Delivery is on, the Logistics Manager regularly checks the open orders of your company, in the same priority order as the Shipping Exit, and orders the items that are in stock. Unlike the Shipping Exit, he does not wait for the full quantity of an order, he orders what is available. The packages are sent to the target address. From there, your own logistics have to bring them to a Shipping Exit, which then delivers the order. To avoid ordering the same items twice, the Logistics Manager keeps track of how many items he has already ordered for each order. If any items get lost on the way, you can reset the tracked progress for one order or for all of them.
The minimum stock applies to each item separately. The Logistics Manager only orders what exceeds the minimum stock and leaves the rest in storage.
A Logistics Manager with a connected logistics network.
wiki.createkontor.page.managers.p1: You can run a company together with other players. The owner can invite other players to their company as managers using the Kontor Desk. A player can always be manager or owner of only one company at a time. Managers can either leave a company again by themselves or they can get fired by the owner.
wiki.createkontor.page.managers.p2: Managers can do everything the owner can, except for inviting / firing managers and declaring bankruptcy.
wiki.createkontor.page.managers.title: Managers
wiki.createkontor.page.market_participat: Holding a license for a market does not mean that you automatically participate in the market. Instead you can control your participation independently, as long as you have at least one license for the market. In the Kontor Desk you can decide whether to participate in a market. When you participate, you can set a price and will start to receive requests for the product. Your reputation on the market is not influenced when you decide to stop participating. The daily fee of a license is booked regardless of whether you participate in the market or not.
wiki.createkontor.page.market_share.p1: The market share determines how much of the daily demand you will receive in the form of requests. You can see your market share using a market analyst.
wiki.createkontor.page.market_share.p2: The market share is made up of your price and your reputation. Selling below market price with a high reputation will get you more market share than selling above market price with a low reputation.
wiki.createkontor.page.markets.p1: There are many simulated markets for different items. Each market has a price, demand, simulated competitors and overflow. You can analyse these factors using a market analyst.
wiki.createkontor.page.markets.p2: The price of a market is made up of two components: Price Level and Price Deviation. Price Level is the structural level of a product depending on competitor utilisation and reference cost (= the minimum cost of a product derived from the recipe tree). It is updated once per trading day. The Price Deviation is added onto the price level and makes prices respond directly when a company sells or buys large amounts of items. It is updated several times during a trading day. A price deviation is only temporary and prices will sooner or later return to their price level.
wiki.createkontor.page.markets.p3: Each market has a demand which is determined by a base demand times and the current economic phase. In the long run demand will always rise and companies will have to keep up with that.
wiki.createkontor.page.markets.p4: Every market also simulates competitors alongside player-run companies in the market. Simulated competitors are not full companies but rather the result of several calculations. Competitors will get founded or go bankrupt. The amount of competitors therefor always fluctuates. The production of competitors grows in the long run and they are able to keep up with rising demand. Competitors always sell at market price with a reputation of 3.0.
wiki.createkontor.page.markets.p5: When a market does not have enough production capacity, demand can occasionally go unserved. This creates overflow (more demand than competitors and player-run companies can keep up with) and may be an opportunity for new companies to enter the market.
wiki.createkontor.page.markets.title: Markets
wiki.createkontor.page.policy_rate.title: Policy Rate
wiki.createkontor.page.reputation.p1: Each company has a reputation for each market it participates in. Reputation is one of the two factors directly determining the market share. Successfully completing an order increases your reputation for that product. Failing to complete an order hurts your reputation. In a fresh market, you will start with a neutral reputation of 3.0 stars. You can see your reputation in a market using a market analyst.
wiki.createkontor.page.reputation.p2: If you do not complete any orders in a market for one trading day, your reputation will slowly drift back to 3.0 stars.
wiki.createkontor.page.reputation.p3: Legal level upgrades require a minimum overall reputation. This overall reputation is the weighted average of all individual market reputations.
wiki.createkontor.page.reputation.title: Reputation
wiki.createkontor.page.requests_orders.p: When you participate in a market, you will start to receive requests for that product. A request only stays on the board for a short amount of time in which you can accept it before disappearing.
An accepted request turns into an order. You will now need to fulfill the order in time or your reputation gets hurt. Use the shipping exit to fulfill orders.
When the deadline of an order expires, a grace period starts. In this short period, you can still fulfill the order, but you will only receive a partial payout.
The higher your legal level is, the shorter deadlines are and the larger the orders are.
wiki.createkontor.page.shipping_exit.p1: The shipping exit allows you to fulfill orders. When powered it will try to fulfill as many orders as possible sorted by urgency. To fulfill an order, all required items need to be present in an adjacent inventory. The items will then be pulled from those inventories.
wiki.createkontor.page.shipping_exit.p2: Orders that are in their grace period (= deadline expired) have the highest priority and will be fulfilled first. All other orders come next sorted by their remaining time until the deadline is reached.
wiki.createkontor.page.shipping_exit.p3: A comparator can be used to check whether an order has been completed or not. If an order has been completed it will output a power level of 15 for 6 ticks.
wiki.createkontor.page.shipping_exit.sce: A basic shipping exit setup. The pulse timer powers the shipping exit regularly.
